name: cswap
description: claude-swap inside Claude Code: an accounts pane, /swap, a usage status line and opt-in auto-switching. Needs the cswap binary.

auto_switch.title: Auto-switch
auto_switch.description: Every 2 minutes run cswap auto --once: switch accounts before the active one hits its limit (threshold: cswap config set autoswitch.threshold).

cswap_path.title: cswap binary
cswap_path.description: Optional. Full path to cswap(.exe); empty looks on PATH, then %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\cswap\cswap.exe.
